title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-09-06
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard (No Dolby) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Decent 1969 soundboard bootleg with solid Garcia tone and standout Big Boy Pete, but uneven early‑track volume and mixed energy.
ai_review.review: The set captures a typical early‑'69 Dead show – solid Garcia guitar work and memorable moments like Big Boy Pete, He Was A Friend Of Mine, Good Lovin’ and It’s All Over Now. Recording quality is generally good with a strong mix on later tracks, though the first three cuts suffer from low volume and tape hiss. The performance swings between sluggish openings and higher‑energy highlights, giving the release an overall mixed but enjoyable feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality averages around a solid 3½ based on varied fan comments; recording is generally good but has noticeable flaws, leading to an overall rating of about 3.5 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First three tracks have low volume and tape‑hiss; fourth track (Big Boy Pete) has proper levels, a clean mix and high‑quality audio. Overall the soundboard source is listenable with some inconsistencies.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical early‑'69 snippet set with rare tracks (Schoolgirl, Big Boy Pete) and a few extended jams; the pacing feels uneven, starting sluggishly then picking up momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Lead vocal on Good Lovin'; Garcia's guitar tone described as rock‑solid and strong throughout.
